newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index edges lower, trade down.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index edges lower, trade down.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Thursday closed down by 0.13 percent in lower trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 503.35 from 504.01 last Tuesday.
Total volume was 2.13 million dinars against 3.72 million dinars. Turnover on the first market was 1.6 million dinars.
Banque Nationale Agricole bank declined 0.29 dinar to 31.5 dinars with 35,700 shares changing hands. Amen Bank edged lower 0.12 dinar to 36 dinars.
Chemical firm Al-Kimia was up 0.7 dinar to 49.98 dinars. Arab Tunisian Bank rose 0.62 dinar to 34.5 dinars. Investment fund SPDIT-SICAF advanced 0.5 dinar to 19 dinars.
Coca and beer bottler SFBT was down 0.5 dinar to 93 dinars. ($1= 1.09 dinar)
